notes: What the escape hatch looks like when it is used deliberately. This overlay DOES make SELECT 1 EXECUTE('...') return allow on every engine, which is a real and severe loosening of a gate whose whole purpose is to refuse dynamic execution.

It is here so the test suite demonstrates what a declared exemption buys and costs, and so that the shape of a dangerous-but-valid overlay is on file. It is a fixture. It must never be shipped as an operator ruleset.

forbidden_statements.safe_as_function: This claim is false and is written here only to show that nothing in the package checks it: EXECUTE('...') is valid T-SQL, so a reader of this overlay's diff is the only thing standing between this sentence and dynamic execution.
